# WHONET Organism Codes to SNOMED CT - Botswana AMR Implementation Guide v0.1.0

* [**Table of Contents**](toc.md)
* [**Artifacts Summary**](artifacts.md)
* **WHONET Organism Codes to SNOMED CT**

## ConceptMap: WHONET Organism Codes to SNOMED CT 

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| *Official URL*:http://bw.health.gov/fhir/ConceptMap/whonet-organism-to-snomed | *Version*:0.1.0 |
| Draft as of 2026-03-13 | *Computable Name*:WHONETOrganismToSNOMED |

 
Maps WHONET organism codes to SNOMED CT concepts. Derived from the AMR R package (https://github.com/msberends/AMR) which integrates WHONET organism codes with SNOMED CT mappings. Contains 4995 WHONET organism codes.
